task.description:
Design ISS-401..404. Write FOUR Type E prose design docs.

Read first: docs/requirements/BPM_Architecture_Backlog.20260611.md (ISS-401..404 sections), src/api/middleware/auth.zig, src/oidc/*, src/identity/service.zig, src/config/*, templates/lego-catalog.md.

1. src/design/iss401_shared_rate_limiter.md — ISS-401:
   Shared-store sliding-window rate limiter. Key = (tenant_id, principal).
   principal = api_token.id for local tokens, (realm, sub) for OIDC (see ISS-403).
   Backend: BPM_RATE_LIMIT_BACKEND = postgres (default) or redis.
   Postgres impl: INSERT INTO rate_limit_buckets + cleanup; Redis: INCR + EXPIRE.
   Return 429 + Retry-After header on exceed. Config validates at startup.
   Global enforcement across nodes (not per-node).

2. src/design/iss402_oidc_cache_revocation.md — ISS-402:
   OIDC token validation: validate against tenant realm issuer/JWKS (no api_tokens row).
   Cache key = (realm, jti) with TTL = min(token.exp, 5min).
   Revocation: jti denylist (SET/HashMap with expiry), NOT the api_tokens LISTEN/NOTIFY.
   Realm logout: add all active jti for that realm to denylist.

3. src/design/iss403_oidc_rate_limit_keying.md — ISS-403:
   ISS-401/402 dependent: OIDC principals keyed (tenant_id, realm, sub) in rate limiter.
   After OIDC token validation succeeds, extract sub claim for rate-limit key.
   Local tokens remain keyed on api_token.id.

4. src/design/iss404_token_role_snapshot.md — ISS-404:
   Token roles are fixed at issuance time (snapshot from user_roles).
   Token validation reads roles from api_tokens.roles[] (not user_roles).
   Changing user_roles after issuance does NOT alter the token's effective roles.
   Must re-issue token to pick up new roles.

No implementation code. Prose signatures and behaviour only.
acceptance_criteria: iss401: sliding-window algorithm, key structure, backend choice, 429+Retry-After, config validation described
iss402: JWKS validation, (realm,jti) cache with TTL, jti denylist revocation, realm logout described
iss403: OIDC rate-limit key from (tenant_id, realm, sub), local key from api_token.id described
iss404: token roles snapshot at issuance, user_roles change does not affect issued tokens described
No implementation code in any doc

result.summary: Created 4 Type E design docs: iss401_shared_rate_limiter.md (shared-store sliding-window rate limiter), iss402_oidc_cache_revocation.md (OIDC token validation cache + jti denylist + realm logout), iss403_oidc_rate_limit_keying.md (OIDC principal keying for rate limiter), iss404_token_role_snapshot.md (token roles as point-in-time snapshot)
